d:
Gaya men rajad sansad abhay kushvaha ne kaha ki nitish kumar sath aana chahte hai to aaye aur lalu prasad yadav aur tejasvi yadav ne jis tarah nitish kumar ko mukhyamantri banaya tha aap aaye lalu prasad yadav aur tejasvi yadav usi tarah se nishant kumar ko bihar ka mukhyamantri banaenge.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
